test_title: SSC CGL 2024 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 26 Sept, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.

RN Right's literary works helped redefine discussions __in race relations in America__ in the mid-20th century.
solution:
The correct answer is '4' i.e. of race relations in America.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The phrase **"discussions of race relations in America"** is the grammatically correct and idiomatic expression indicating the subject matter of the discussions.
 
• The other options do not convey the correct meaning:
 
 
• "By race relations in America" suggests that race relations are performing the action, which is incorrect.
 
• "Beside race relations in America" implies a physical location or being next to something, which is not relevant here.
 
• "To race relations in America" suggests direction or purpose, which does not fit the context.
 
 

Hence, the correct answer is option 4.
